## Attendance

The Programme Board met in June 2024. Present were J. Whitfield, S. Rahman, Priya Anand, R. Adeyemi, G. Evans. J. Whitfield chaired the meeting. The attendance record was confirmed, and no apologies were recorded.

## Performance

The board reviewed operational performance for June 2024. There were 2577 captures during the month. The backlog was 303, and the number of letters requiring attention was 46.

Members noted the position and agreed that the current figures should continue to be monitored. Any emerging pressures affecting the backlog or letters should be raised through the usual reporting arrangements.

## Items

The board considered INC-0207 Registry feed repeated reissued numbers. The issue was noted, with further information to be provided at a future meeting. Members agreed that progress should remain visible in the programme’s ongoing review of performance and operational issues.

## Actions

The position on INC-0207 Registry feed repeated reissued numbers will be reviewed at the next meeting. The performance figures for captures, backlog and letters will also be carried forward for continued monitoring.
